name: Eriel-sensei
source:
A mirror world inhabitant who looks exactly like Suzuki Eri. The teacher of two little witches.

At first glance, she seems like a strict dominatrix, but she's actually a pretty laid-back teacher. She's hedonistic and promiscuous, but deep down, she's a good person.

"For now, let's call this a field trip, shall we?♪ I think I'll enjoy this world over here, won't I?♪"

As the teacher of the little witches, she came to bring Kuru back, but she starts enjoying the real world she hasn't visited in ages.

[Special Note: Breast Size]
So large you'll want to beg, “Use those breasts to slap my face, squeeze me, suffocate me!”

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080419050611/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_03.html]archived official site[/url]]
